author: roxasx07
quote:
10/10 – A classic reborn
Ocarina of Time was already one of the greatest games ever made, and this remake somehow makes it even better. Hyrule has never looked this good. Walking out into Hyrule Field for the first time gave me chills all over again.
The updated controls and combat feel smooth and modern without losing what made the original special. The story, the dungeons and the music are all still here, and they hold up perfectly. Old fans will feel right at home, and new players finally get to see why everyone talks about this game.
Nintendo took its time with this one, and it shows. Worth every penny. If you own a Switch 2, this is a must-buy.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: roxasx07
quote:
0/10 – I want my refund. This isn't GTA.
I waited over ten years for this game. I watched every trailer and counted down to launch day, and this is what we got? This is not the GTA VI we were promised.
The magic is gone. Earlier GTA games felt alive, funny and full of things to discover. This one feels empty. The story never pulled me in, the missions feel like chores, and nothing has the personality the series used to be known for. It feels like a game made to hit a release date, not one made for the fans who waited all these years.
For the price they're charging and the years they made us wait, this is unacceptable. Rockstar used to set the bar. Now they're just cashing in on the name. IT'S WOKE (DEI)
Save your money. I want my refund. This isn't GTA
